messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: [P1] inference-api-prod — p99 latency > 1.2s in us-west. Links: https://pagerduty.example/alerts/PD1234
Maya: ACKing, I'm oncall. Joining the bridge now.
PagerDuty: Alert acknowledged by Maya.
Dan: grabbing logs and pod status.
Priya: saw a tail spike in Datadog — p95 jumped ~120ms -> 700ms, p99 ~1.4s. Spike started ~1768009500.
Maya: any obvious 5xx or customer errors?
Priya: no 5xxs, customers complaining about slowness on /generate endpoints.
Dan: quick check — there was a sidecar rollout ~30m ago, tag inference-sidecar@v2.3.4.
Maya: ok, that matches timeline. Can we confirm pod health?
Dan: running: `kubectl -n prod get pods -l app=inference -o wide`
```
NAME                                  READY   STATUS             RESTARTS   AGE
inference-abc-1                        1/2     CrashLoopBackOff   3          1h
inference-abc-2                        2/2     Running            0          1h
inference-def-1                        0/2     CrashLoopBackOff   4          45m
```
Dan: sidecar container repeatedly OOM/killing, main container stays up.
Maya: do we have kvcache evictions or memory pressure?
Priya: KV cache hitrate ok, but sidecar mem usage at ~92% and a lot of GC pauses.
EngInfra-Bot: Autoscaler paused via manual override by maya for 10m: /api/autoscale/pause?by=oncall
Maya: suggest rollback sidecar to v2.3.3 on a small percentage first, then widen. Doing 10% canary rollback.
Priya: adding temporary routing header for fallback: `x-inference-fallback: true` to route to stable model variant.
Dan: applying rollback: `kubectl set image deployment/inference inference-sidecar=image:v2.3.3 --record` on canary subset.
Maya: monitoring p99 and pod readiness.
(7m)
Priya: after canary rollback, p95 dropped to 320ms, p99 900ms — improvement but not fully recovered.
Maya: ramping rollback to 50% now.
Dan: note in logs: multiple grpc timeout retries ~ 504ms then backoff. NATS reconnects visible around 1768009400.
```
E0623 17:12:40.123 grpc_call.go:87 timeout after 504ms
WARN  nats_client.go:212 reconnect attempt 3
```
Maya: temporary mitigation: reduce sidecar worker threads from 8 -> 2 to reduce memory pressure. Priya, can you patch the config?
Priya: patching ConfigMap and rolling restart for sidecar. `kubectl rollout restart deployment/inference` for patched config.
(10m)
incident-bot: Alert update: p99 latency still above threshold (>1.0s) in us-west.
Maya: ACK, continuing mitigation. Dan please verify eviction and GC metrics.
Dan: GC spikes coincide with sidecar memory pressure, heap growth steady. Eviction rate low — it's memory saturation.
Priya: after worker thread reduction and 50% rollback, p95 ~200ms, p99 ~650ms. Dashboard: https://datadog.example/dash/abc/latency?from=1768009000
Maya: good trend. I'll send a brief status to #incidents and to oncall rotation.
Maya: customer impact note — degraded latency for some write-heavy jobs but no increased error rates. Posting status update. :spiral_notepad:
Dan: leaving console monitors up and will watch logs for 1h.
Priya: will prepare RCA doc with timeline, deploys, metrics and proposed fix (sidecar memory regression).
Maya: handing off to Dan for the next shift in ~45m — Dan you're up?
Dan: Yep, I'll own until EOD and escalate if alerts return. Adding notes to the incident doc.
Maya: closing the immediate page. If the alert fires again we'll reopen PagerDuty. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
